rationale: The only match trigger is the prior paid invoice HL-3301 (same PO, same $4,300.00, 19 days apart), but it carries a distinct service period (2026-02-01/2026-02-28 vs 2026-02-15/2026-03-14) and the billed name does not normalise to the prior name, so clause 8 is not satisfied and clause 8.1 treats this as a legitimate recurring charge. PO-4422 is a SERVICES PO, so no goods receipt is expected (clause 1); the monthly rate matches the PO exactly and tax of $300.00 equals 7.5% of $4,000.00 (clause 5). Clean invoice, $4,300.00 payable, AP_CLERK per clause 10.
